134:theorem coeff_taylor (α : σ → R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :

141:theorem eval_taylor (α x : σ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
142:    eval x (taylor α P) = eval (fun j ↦ x j + α j) P := by
143:  simp [taylor, aeval_def, ← eval_assoc, Function.comp_def]
146:theorem taylor_taylor (α β : σ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
147:    taylor α (taylor β P) = taylor (fun j ↦ α j + β j) P := by
148:  simp [taylor, comp_aeval_apply, add_assoc]
152:theorem taylor_zero (P : MvPolynomial σ R) : taylor (fun _ ↦ (0 : R)) P = P := by
153:  simp [taylor, aeval_X_left_apply]
157:theorem taylor_map {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) (α : σ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
158:    taylor (fun j ↦ f (α j)) (map f P) = map f (taylor α P) := by
159:  simp [taylor, aeval_def, map_eval₂, Function.comp_def]
164:theorem taylor_rename {τ : Type*} (f : σ → τ) (α : τ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
165:    taylor α (rename f P) = rename f (taylor (α ∘ f) P) := by
166:  simp [taylor, rename_eq_aeval, comp_aeval_apply]
